digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM class config schema and resolver
propositions: Add three config slots (trivial, standard, frontier) each accepting model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array, parsed from the existing layered config.
Expose a resolver mapping a class name to a provider-qualified model string, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted so bare model ids resolve as today.
When a slot is unset, each class resolves to today's default bare id (frontier=claude-opus-4-8, standard=claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial=claude-haiku-4-5), preserving current behaviour bit-for-bit.
Structured slots are addressed per-field by scalar env vars (e.g. REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL) preserving the CLI>env>config-file>default precedence per key.
A slot containing api_key must be rejected with a typed config error, enforcing the env-only secrets boundary.
The fallback array is config-file-only, parsed and carried on the record but not yet consumed at runtime.
